data.name: Admin_About
data.value: Displays basic information about the AddIn, and provides a means to directly access the related project GitHub.

data.name: Admin_GetAdminCode
data.value: Provides a form to enter a user's name and get the corresponding request response code that Oi will look for in that user's Local AppData folder when Revit launches.

data.name: Admin_GetBypassCode
data.value:
Provides a form to enter a bypass request code, which will generate a response code that can be used to enable the protection bypass.
Note that this code will be unique to the Elements involved in the request, so will only work for the specific bypass being attempted.

data.name: Admin_SelfAppointAsAdmin
data.value:
Registers you as an Administrator, which will write a request response code to your Local AppData folder. When Revit boots up, Oi will look at this folder to determine if a user is an Administrator.
If this file is not found with a valid code, Oi will load in low trust mode without access to its Tools ribbon.

data.name: Admin
data.value: Tools related to administrating access to Oi's Tab, and permitting user's to bypass protection when required.

data.name: Delete
data.value: Tools related to protecting Elements from deletion.

data.name: Modify
data.value: Tools related to protecting Elements from modification. Note that Elements protected in this way can still be deleted unless they also have Delete protection applied.

data.name: Delete_SelectProtectedElements
data.value: Selects all Elements in the current Document that currently have protection applied from being deleted.

data.name: Modify_SelectProtectedElements
data.value: Selects all Elements in the current Document that currently have protection applied from being modified.

data.name: Delete_ProtectionReview
data.value:
Displays a form that provides information about protected Elements in the current Document, including when, who and why the Elements were protected.
This form will be presented to users if they attempt to delete protected Elements as well.

data.name: Modify_ProtectionReview
data.value:
Displays a form that provides information about protected Elements in the current Document, including when, who and why the Elements were protected.
This form will be presented to users if they attempt to modify protected Elements as well.

data.name: Delete_ProtectSelectedElements
data.value: Applies protection to any selected Element(s) without it currently of this type. You will be prompted to also provide a basic summary of the purpose of protection, so that end users have a better understanding of why they may encounter prevention mechanisms in future.

data.name: Modify_ProtectSelectedElements
data.value: Applies protection to any selected Element(s) without it currently of this type. You will be prompted to also provide a basic summary of the purpose of protection, so that end users have a better understanding of why they may encounter prevention mechanisms in future.

data.name: Delete_UnprotectSelectedElements
data.value: Removes protection from any selected Element(s) with it currently of this type. This tool can only be ran by administrators as it does not trigger a bypass code to be validated unlike if an end user tries to bypass protection when offered.

data.name: Modify_UnprotectSelectedElements
data.value: Removes protection from any selected Element(s) with it currently of this type. This tool can only be ran by administrators as it does not trigger a bypass code to be validated unlike if an end user tries to bypass protection when offered.
